# Shortcuts accepted by TestUIStyleGuard (internal/archtest/ui_style_test.go).
#
# One line per file and per kind: "<kind> <file> <count>". The list only
# shrinks: a new shortcut fails the test, and so does a count that went down
# (or a file with none left) until its line is updated here or removed. Never
# raise a count to make the test pass: take the color from the theme
# (theme.Paint, ColorTag, ColorTagOf, BgTag, StyleTag) and the symbol from its
# table of meanings (theme.Sym*).
#
# kinds: tag-color, tag-style, color-literal, symbol (see the test)
#
